title: oldenlandia yunnanensis
intro: Oldenlandia yunnanensis, commonly known as Yunnanensis oldenlandia, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a traditional Chinese herb used in medicine for its potential health benefits. Research has shown that Oldenlandia yunnanensis exhibits anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
